svg.text: The walk round the ring - 2.4x faster than the clock error explains
the same ring as ts_modular_ring.svg, cut at delta = 0 and laid against time: predicted from the talker's own PHC rate error vs the period the listener's counters show
LATE - delta at or above 2^31 reads BEHIND
delta = (avtp_timestamp - ptp_now) mod 2^32 - the whole ring, cut at 0
t (s) into the 484 s counter sweep
observed, from the strip below: 90.6 s -> 2.37x FASTER, unexplained
the same walk as a ring, and what the listener's counters actually did - each bar is one 20 s GET_COUNTERS sweep
the t = 161 s sample breaks monotonicity: a ~20 s excursion, far too fast for a walk - excluded here, and not explained anywhere
and the two polarities are not equal halves: EARLY blocks 80.5 and 80.0 s, LATE blocks 101.0 and 101.0 s - also unexplained (+/- 10 s from the sweep cadence)
half-period from the four surviving gaps [80.5, 101.0, 80.0, 101.0] s -> mean 90.6 s against 214.7 s predicted
the mechanism is settled; the RATE is not. Implied relative rate 23696 ppm against 10004 ppm measured on the talker - a 2.37x gap this record does not close.
